definitions.explanation: An artificial channel built to supply water for agriculture, industry, or other uses. Common in rural Japan for rice paddy irrigation.

examples.japanese: {田|た}んぼに{水|みず}を{引|ひ}く{用水路|ようすいろ}がある。
examples.english: There is an irrigation channel that supplies water to the rice paddies.

examples.japanese: {用水路|ようすいろ}の{掃除|そうじ}は{地域|ちいき}の{住民|じゅうみん}が{協力|きょうりょく}して{行|おこな}う。
examples.english: Cleaning the irrigation channels is done cooperatively by the local residents.

examples.japanese: {大雨|おおあめ}で{用水路|ようすいろ}の{水|みず}があふれて、{道路|どうろ}が{冠水|かんすい}した。
examples.english: The water overflowed from the irrigation channel due to heavy rain, and the road was flooded.

notes: A compound of {用水|ようすい} (water for use, utility water) and {路|ろ} (route, channel). In rural Japan, maintaining {用水路|ようすいろ} is traditionally a communal responsibility. During heavy rains, overflowing channels can be dangerous — every year, accidents occur when people try to check on {用水路|ようすいろ} during storms. Related terms: {水路|すいろ} (waterway, more general), {灌漑|かんがい} (irrigation), and {排水路|はいすいろ} (drainage channel).
